value.rationale: The fixed-area reserve tradeoff is an important natural model question; the theorem provides an exact, positive-width all-exponent zone where mean lifetime favors two reserves but long-deadline survival favors one. Unlike a single numerical counterexample, the sharp threshold identity exposes a structural distinction between mean and tail objectives and locates the complete boundary of the reversal.
